# Global Fact Checking

> A collaborative network of international journalists, analysts, and experts dedicated to debunking disinformation and analyzing geopolitical narratives across the Middle East, digital governance, and global media.

Global Fact Checking aggregates fact-checking publications and geopolitical analysis from a diverse network of contributors including academics, counter-hegemony researchers, and media professionals. The platform focuses on emerging disinformation tactics, digital platform accountability, and critical examination of narratives in conflict zones.

## Key Topics

- Fact-checking
- Disinformation analysis
- Digital governance
- Platform accountability
- Democratic deficit
- Middle East conflict
- Geopolitical experts
- International organizations
- Media professionals
- Counter-hegemony
- AI-generated content
- Journalists and analysts
- European Union regulation
- Digital Services Act
- Conspiracy theory debunking

- [Democratic Deficit in Digital Governance: From Rights Protection to Administrative Concentration of Power — II](https://globalfactchecking.com/democratic-deficit-in-digital-governance-from-rights-protection-to-administrative-concentration-of-power): EU Digital Services Act compliance and platform accountability

## Conspiracy Theory Debunking

- [Beyond the "Collarbone Conspiracy": Deconstructing the Rise of Transvestigation](https://globalfactchecking.com/beyond-the-collarbone-conspiracy-deconstructing-the-rise-of-transvestigation): Debunking transvestigation conspiracy theory with forensic analysis
